arguments.title: Contacts adapter over a paging service
arguments.summary: Builds one file, src/adapter.mjs, that turns the contacts service's raw status/body responses into a plain list/get/create API (paging handled internally, 404 becomes null, errors become named JS errors), and records in integration/manifest.json which of the 9 frozen conformance cases it satisfies. One card - the deliverable is small and the two files are one coherent piece of work. No open questions; the spec is fully deterministic and the frozen test suite is the only acceptance check.
arguments.spec:
# Contacts adapter — integration brief

`service/contacts-service.mjs` is a small, deterministic, in-process API. `request(method, path, options)` ALWAYS
returns `{ status, body }` and NEVER throws. Routes: `GET /contacts` (query.limit 1..3, optional query.cursor) ->
`200 {items, nextCursor|null}` or `400 bad_limit/bad_cursor`; `GET /contacts/:id` -> `200 contact` or `404 not_found`;
`POST /contacts` `{name,email}` -> `201 contact` or `422 validation_failed` with `error.fields`. Error bodies are
always `{ error: { code, message, ... } }`.

`src/adapter.mjs` must export `createContactsClient(service)` returning:
- `listAll()` - EVERY contact, in service order, by following `nextCursor` until it is `null`; never request a
  limit outside 1..3, never send a cursor on the first call, never keep asking once there is no next page.
- `get(id)` - the contact, or `null` on `not_found` (a 404 is an answer, not a failure).
- `create(input)` - the created contact, or reject with `ValidationError{fields}` on `validation_failed`.
- any other non-2xx anywhere rejects with `ServiceError{status, code}`; a failure while listing must propagate,
  never returning a short list as though it were complete.

Frozen evidence (do not touch): service/, conformance/, test/integration.test.js, scripts/run-tests.mjs - digest
checked every run. Deliverable: src/adapter.mjs (replacing the throwing stub) plus integration/manifest.json,
whose `implemented` lists the conformance case ids (C01-C09) that actually pass; every case listed is RUN
immediately, and `complete:true` demands every one of them.
arguments.plan:
One card. Implement src/adapter.mjs: listAll() loops GET /contacts with {limit:3} and no cursor key on
the first call, threads nextCursor into query.cursor on later calls, stops when nextCursor is null, concatenates
items, and rethrows any non-200 as ServiceError before returning a partial list. get(id) maps 200->body,
404/not_found->null, else->ServiceError. create(input) maps 201->body, 422/validation_failed->ValidationError
{fields: body.error.fields}, else->ServiceError. Then set integration/manifest.json implemented:[C01..C09],
complete:true, and confirm with the real `npm test` (frozen suite) before finishing.

tasks.prompt:
Implement `src/adapter.mjs` per specification.md, exporting `createContactsClient(service)`. The service
(`service/contacts-service.mjs`) is a small, deterministic, in-process API whose `request(method, path, options)`
call ALWAYS returns `{ status, body }` and NEVER throws -- turning that status into an outcome is the whole job.

- `listAll()`: return EVERY contact, in service order, by following `nextCursor` across pages (the service pages
  at 3 per request: send `limit` 1..3, never attach a cursor on the first call, follow `nextCursor` UNTIL it is
  `null`, and never ask again once it is). A failure mid-listing must propagate as a `ServiceError` -- NEVER
  swallow it into a short list.
- `get(id)`: return the contact on 200; return `null` (not a throw) when the service reports `404 not_found` -- a
  missing record is an answer, not a failure.
- `create(input)`: return the created contact on 201; on `422 validation_failed` reject with an `Error` named
  `ValidationError` carrying `fields` copied from the service's `error.fields`.
- Any other non-2xx from ANY call rejects with an `Error` named `ServiceError` carrying `status` and the service's
  `error.code` as `code`.

Then declare which of the 9 frozen conformance cases (`conformance/cases.mjs`: C01..C09) your adapter satisfies in
`integration/manifest.json`'s `implemented` array, and set `complete: true` only once EVERY case actually passes --
the harness RUNS every case you list, immediately, so listing one that still fails is strictly worse than an empty
manifest. Some cases assert the CALL LOG (page size, cursor use across calls), not just return values -- fetching
everything and filtering locally will not pass C02/C03.

`service/`, `conformance/`, `test/integration.test.js` and `scripts/run-tests.mjs` are FROZEN evidence with digest
checks recorded in `test/frozen.json` -- do not touch them. Run the real `npm test` yourself before finishing; a
green baseline with an empty manifest proves nothing, so confirm the count you see names your own 9 passing cases.
